A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PI-DEF study. All 15 pages of each version, including figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–D, support comparison. The relocated references and supplementary material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original simulated black-hole reconstruction experiments, comparisons with BH-NeRF and 4D-MLP, and a velocity-prior ablation in Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments, including the quantitative reconstruction results in Table 1 and the supplementary ablation in Figure 10.

M1.justification: The emissivity and velocity networks, rendering procedure, three loss components, and optimization method are unchanged. Correcting the Figure 1 label from PINeRF to PI-DEF does not introduce a different method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same simulated emissivity fields and full-image, EHT 2017, EHT 2025, and ngEHT measurement scenarios. Gaussian-noise and closure-phase evaluations are also retained without expanded coverage.

E2.justification: BH-NeRF and 4D-MLP remain the comparators in Table 1 and Figure 3. Comparator participation in the other experiments, including BH-NeRF in Figure 7, is unchanged.

E3.justification: The five-field evaluation, PSNR/MSE calculations, observation settings, and 100K-step optimization protocol are unchanged. Table 2 moves within the supplement but retains every parameter value.

E4.justification: The measurement-sparsity, emissivity-signal, velocity-parameterization, noise, and spin-sensitivity analyses are retained. Appendix A and Figure 10 report the same velocity-prior mismatch ablation.

E5.justification: Table 1 reports the same mean and standard deviation across five test emissivity fields in both versions. No seed information, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance-testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Table 1 retains PSNR values of 37.3 ± 2.3, 35.4 ± 0.5, and 34.0 ± 1.9 dB for PI-DEF, 4D-MLP, and BH-NeRF, respectively, with unchanged MSE values. The remaining numerical results, plotted findings, and supplementary reconstructions also match.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(61), physical assumptions, velocity conversions, AART formulas, and closure-phase derivations are unchanged. Reorganizing the supplement adds no mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: joint emissivity and velocity recovery, improved reconstruction over existing approaches, and potential inference of black-hole spin.

C2.justification: Section 5.4 qualifies the description of full images as providing the highest-possible measurement resolution by adding 'from Earth.' This modestly narrows the interpretation; the other explanations and limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix B retain the same architecture, hyperparameters, simulation instructions, solver, hardware, and runtime information. The newly inserted generic Overleaf address in Section 4.2 supplies no reproducibility resource or access instructions.

R1.justification: The same 51 works are cited, and the substantive positioning relative to prior research is retained. Section 5.2 shortens BH-NeRF's description to 'the previous method,' while the introduction retains the existing exclusivity claim.

P1.justification: v2 lightly rewrites the introduction and baseline description, corrects wording, updates affiliations and funding acknowledgments, adds a supplement contents list, and places references before the supplement. It also introduces a stray Overleaf address after Section 4.2.

P2.justification: Figure 1 corrects its method label from PINeRF to PI-DEF. Table 2 moves to the supplement's second page, and the contents list and relocated references cause layout reflow. The scientific displays otherwise retain their content and structure.

improvement.justification: The methodology, empirical evidence, mathematical development, and reproducibility information are unchanged. The corrected Figure 1 label, supplement contents list, and terrestrial-resolution qualification slightly improve clarity and navigation, while the stray Overleaf address in Section 4.2 introduces an editorial blemish. These limited changes leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
